Subject: Week 21 forecast turn-in: pairing & evidence checklist

Team / Brightlane,

Quick turn-in note for Week 21 (submission window closes 05/22 17:00 PT):

Primary asks
- Update Salesforce stage to the final agreed stage (Negotiation, Legal, or Commit) by EOD Wednesday. If you change stage, add a 1-line reason in the Stage Notes field.
- Pair ownership: I attached account-pairing.csv — please confirm a second reviewer for each ACV > $50k. Use the Reviewer column to add initials.
- Evidence packets: populate the Q2_forecast_template.xlsx (attached) for any deals you want counted in commit. Include doc links under the Evidence column.

Risk flags
- Mark any deal with open procurement terms, expected >10% probability drop, or unresolved security asks with the red "risk" tag in SFDC so RevOps can triage.

Call cadence
- 15-minute sync tomorrow (05/21) at 10:00 PT for late-stage triage. Join if you have accounts with missing evidence. Link in Drive.

Brightlane (Emma): can you confirm procurement ETA and whether the SOW draft in my attachments is up-to-date? If you need a separate cadence, tell us and we’ll carve time.

I’ll run an automated sweep on Thursday morning and follow up with any accounts that need handoff.

Thanks,
--
Soojin Lee
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: Q2_forecast_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), account-pairing.csv (csv)
